notes: This attempt reaches the actual DxgkDdiPresent entrypoint after staging allocation creation/open succeeds. Four calls report insufficient DMA buffer with no progress. One earlier clear is accepted for submission. This log has no worker-completion trace, so it does not establish completion of that clear.

The kernel then rejects patching an empty presentation packet. Windows bugchecks 0x119 with parameter 1=3 (DRIVER_FAILED_PATCH_COMMAND). The probe never writes a completion/exit report and no displayed frame is verified.

Source inspection identifies a concrete size mismatch: CreateContext advertises sizeof(CopyRecord)=40 private bytes, while Present requires at least sizeof(PresentRecord)=64. Thus even a fresh context buffer cannot hold one rectangle. The captured trace has no direct buffer-size dump; this diagnosis follows the exact package source and returned progress/status.

Revision 2e3eaf1 advertises storage for the bounded presentation record array. Tests now create the context through the actual DDI and require its advertised DMA/private/patch budgets to fit the emitted rectangles. Live acceptance remains a separate gate.

Only the disposable VM crashed. Its Windows crash handler saved a dump and rebooted. The registered driver is removed after reboot; this does not retroactively establish clean teardown of the crashed attempt. No driver was installed on the physical Delta host.
